outcomes.statement: Group Admins see, on SCR-usage (/uso), per-person last activity and days inactive for their companies against a lag-aware data-through date, with company and 30/60/90 window filters, active/flagged/no-data metric cards, window and state badges, and the ~3-day freshness banner.

outcomes.statement: Group Admins select inactive people on SCR-usage and propose reclamation in one audited batch with an optional note, creating at most one pending ReclamationProposal per open assignment.

outcomes.statement: An audited daily inactivityFlagging job after analyticsSync sets flagged_inactive on the anchor LicenseRequest of each open assignment whose person has more than 30 days of inactivity against lag-aware data_through, returns flagged_inactive to active when activity resumes, leaves other states untouched and creates no proposals; 60/90 days are display filters only.

uncertainties.resolution: US-026 (with children US-070/US-071) has a terminal done event and is dev_done; activity_record carries activity_date and synced_at. Recorded as a resolved prerequisite, not a blocked_by dependency.

uncertainties.statement: Inactivity policy, proposal idempotency and flag ownership are now canonical.
uncertainties.resolution: CHG-071 delivered DEC-SMP-026/027/028 and docs/specs/09b_business_rules.md BR-16: lag-aware data_through; existing pending-proposal partial UNIQUE, client_request_id audited only, no migration; daily flagging after analyticsSync at the 30-day window, 60/90 display-only, no auto-proposals, flagged_inactive -> active when activity resumes.

uncertainties.statement: The parent exceeds execution limits (750 min > 320, five scopes, five acceptance flows, 24 files, three primary outcomes).
uncertainties.resolution: Partitioned into three vertical children of 260, 230 and 260 minutes; every parent AC is assigned and duplicated coverage carries a rationale. US-028 keeps approve/dismiss, suppression after dismissal, offboarding and /reclamaciones.

partitions.title: Usage surface: lag-aware inactivity per person on SCR-usage
partitions.outcome: Group Admins see, on SCR-usage (/uso), per-person last activity and days inactive for their companies against a lag-aware data-through date, with company and 30/60/90 window filters, active/flagged/no-data metric cards, window and state badges, and the ~3-day freshness banner.
partitions.demo: Seed two companies with activity at varied ages and a vendor account synced three days ago: /uso as group_admin lists only own-company people, days inactive counts from the data-through date (a person last active on the last synced day shows 0, not 3), the 30/60/90 filter changes the badge set and metric cards, people with no activity count as no data; a non-group_admin role is refused.

uncertainties.statement: The lag-aware policy is canonical and shared with US-074.
uncertainties.resolution: DEC-SMP-026 and BR-16 define days inactive = data_through - last activity_date, using the latest synced activity_date for the person vendor account, or evaluation date - 3 days when never synced. US-072 owns one pure domain function for lag and 30/60/90 window math; US-074 reuses it. No activity means no data, never inactive. Property tests constrain monotonicity and exact window boundaries.

uncertainties.statement: Existing inactive-candidate queries (pool-repository.ts:97, read-repository.ts:401) use wall-clock evaluation dates without lag.
uncertainties.resolution: The usage repository is new and uses the shared lag function; the two existing queries are left unchanged (their consumers are other stories) and the divergence is recorded as a deviation for a follow-up.

partitions.cross_cutting_rationale: AC1 is split: this child delivers the screen's filters, metric cards, last-active and badges; the batch proposal is the propose child. AC2 is split: this child applies the lag to displayed windows; the flagging child applies the same function to the state flag.

uncertainties.resolution: DEC-SMP-027 uses the existing partial UNIQUE on pending proposals per assignment (V20260725180000) with insert-on-conflict-do-nothing. client_request_id is accepted and recorded in audit, not persisted on the proposal. No migration.

uncertainties.statement: Daily flagging and un-flagging ownership is canonical.
uncertainties.resolution: DEC-SMP-028, BR-16 and US-074 AC1-AC3 require inactivityFlagging after analyticsSync: active -> flagged_inactive for more than 30 days; flagged_inactive -> active on renewed activity; all other states left alone. 60/90 are display-only. No proposals are created.

uncertainties.statement: Concurrent job runs or a manual transition racing the job.
uncertainties.resolution: Conditional UPDATE on the expected current state (active for flagging, flagged_inactive for renewed-activity return) in one transaction with RequestTransition and audit. Real-DB fixtures prove rerun and manual-transition race safety for both directions.
